 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Treat every non-separator 2x2 patch as a cell; mark patches containing
    # more than one occurrence of the foreground color (5).
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) >= h * w // 8 and v != 5), None)
    # Separators are full-width/full-height lines; infer them by finding
    # uniform rows and columns, then inspect the rectangles between them.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Use actual separator rows/columns; their common value is not foreground.
    row_bands = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if r > start:
            row_bands.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_bands = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if c > start:
            col_bands.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_bands:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_bands:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if count > 1 else 3)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
